horoscopes.horoscope: Ideas play havoc in your head today. The good thing is that you will execute them well. Here is a word of caution for you: avoid hasty decisions. Experienced people will help you find a firm footing. Ganesha advises you to pay heed to elders’ counselling. If you have planned a meeting with your loved one or partner, she or he will be glad to see you at the meeting place in time. It will be a good meeting between both of you. You will handle the day very perfectly. Ganesha feels that today you will be looking at small small things connected with your daily routine. These things will make you feel stressed and worried. Only by being practical and objective,you will be able to handle these things well. Ganesha strongly feels that today you are most likely to have more pragmatic approach towards money matters. You may receive some good news about your career. You may be very practical about your work and related matters. It’s a good day for planning and related works, feels Ganesha. It is best day to plan the schedule of next week or even work on excel sheet to check various ratios.

Ganesha sees you being very planned and focuses, poised and practical in handling your affairs today. You’ll be able to take identify the best strategy, course of action that the situations demand. This day you would be performing like a specialist, a real expert and will not fail to accomplish whatever you have set out to do. Most likely you will be taking up several projects and assignments in course of the day. The day will be good for you from love relationship point of view, feels Ganesha. You may devote enough time to love life, which will add some plus points to the relationship. This is going to help you and make you happy. You will be happy and in good mood today. You will have positive mental outlook. You will feel more energetic. Although you may not have any health problem, you will remain health conscious. There will be strong desire to maintain health. Today, your luck is favouring you so you might want to try it. If you have already invested money in the stock market, today you might want to do away with some stock and earn money. Instead of working on new projects, you may feel like having a close look at the list of issues to be addressed. Besides routine work, you may do some value addition to your work. Overall, it’s a good day from work perspective.

The idea of being with your family will keep you motivated throughout the day. In business, your inquisitive approach will do you a lot of good. In fact, you will have the proverbial Midas touch — whichever venture you put your hands on will turn into a glittering success. It’s going to be good from love relationship point of view, says Ganesha. You will spend more time with your beloved. This togetherness could give you more happiness. If you are married, you would want to get married or engaged. It’s important to have communication in the lighter vein. It will keep you in good health and mood. It will also help a great deal in handling everything that’s going on in your life. It’s very important for you as you could face stressful situations. Your finances are looking positive today. Your financial future looks brighter with the investment that you decide on today. Also for any future investments property is the best bet for you. Domestic requirements and demands may rule your mind today. Being logical and practical by nature, you will be able to handle these things well along with your routine office work. Besides, Ganesha suggests you not to get into conflicts with superiors.

Today, you will strictly follow your plan book. All Ganesha needs to do to predict your day is take a peep into the book. However, this is only one of those rare days when things go according to plan. You are likely to keep your views to yourself, and will hardly betray what’s on your mind. Your love life is likely to suffer today. Ganesha feels you would not be able to pay due attention to love life which may bother your beloved for no reason. You need to be careful about this. Else it will impact your love life. Ganesha feels that today you will be less emotional and more practical. This is not your basic nature but at least you will not be guided by emotions. Your mood swings will be in control which is a good thing. Your ‘feel’ about your finances will be bit sad because your logic will keep telling you that you could have earned well, you could have done better etc. Ganesha advises you to stay positive. You may be in a mood to do research and development today. Your mind would be so active that you will not be able to think about anything else then work. Ganesha suggests you to document every idea that comes to your mind.

Even slender shoulders gain the strength when the time comes to handle responsibilities. And so shall you, says Ganesha, as today brings with it an increased amount of responsibility. You may find yourself drained of all your energy by the end of it. After all, handling important tasks is a tough thing. But when you look back, the satisfaction of having done a job well shall wipe out all the stress, and rejuvenate you. Expect a pleasant surprise when you return home after a long day’s work, says Ganesha. You will be in advising mood today. However, that should not hurt your interests, feels Ganesha. As far as you are in advising mood, please keep a check that you don’t hurt your beloved through over-criticism. You should keep a check on your criticism. You are likely to get upset by someone and you will have to guard against your emotional imbalance. Besides, you should maintain good and balanced diet even if you are offered good food today. Limiting your quantity of food will help you maintain good health. If you are self-employed or freelancer, today you are going to earn very well. You are royal by nature; however, due to today’s favourable planetary position is going to keep tight strings on your purses. You may be very verbal and talkative today. Ganesha finds you in a mood of giving suggestions to everyone around you. Nevertheless, be careful that you are not hurt in case your suggestions are given a deaf ear. Do take care of that.

A day to look inside and contemplate. Find peace and prosperity, says Ganesha. Clam up like those oysters and discover the peal within you. A fine helping hand you shall lend today to those who need it, says Ganesha. The day is going to be good from love life point of view, feels Ganesha. You are likely to give time to your partner too, apart from your love life. Lovers may find a positive turning point in their romantic life. Your ability to plan things will remain on the forefront so today you should plan your day and schedule. Ganesha feels that you will also maintain very good health today by taking balanced diet. Emotional outbursts will be in control. You will be controlling your budget with all necessary practical considerations. You will be modest about your financial standing and will carry no pride for what you have been able to accumulate till date. You may wish to establish proper work routine and schedule in order to perform better at workplace. You may be putting lot many specifics in these areas while you are at work. You may be very judgemental and precise while at work.

“Efforts made are never in vain, even when they may seem otherwise”. Let this be your motto for the day. Today may not seem to be the most productive day, especially when it comes to interviews. You may feel like the rook in the chess set — sometimes coming back to square one despite making many moves forward to the ultimate checkmate! So remember, persistence is the key, says Ganesha. Keep trying and your efforts will bear fruit. You may have lot of office work today. This is going to keep you busy. Ganesha feels office work may keep you too occupied to keep your sweetheart happy. Try to make all possible amendments. You should try to balance the two needs. Your analytical skills will come to play and will help you sort out problems today. You may face several types of problems. You should understand that not all problems can get solved in one shot and they have to be tackled in steps. You will be thinking more before spending money or before say, investing your money. Your basic nature is to keep things in balance and today’s planetary positions are such that you won’t spend recklessly. Being a Libran, problem solving comes naturally to you. Today, Ganesha finds you investing a lot of time and energy in problem solving. However, you may not be able to solve every problem, feels Ganesha. You might feel frustrated due to some unsolved issues.

The day just went from bad to worse today, says Ganesha. Troubles are coming in faster and thicker than a locust swarm. But keep a leash on yourself, says Ganesha, and steer clear of it all. Take criticism in your stride today and pay attention to what is being said, not who is saying them. You should be more flexible with your partner or beloved today, feels Ganesha. Just to add more fun and value to your relationship, Ganesha suggests you let your beloved decide the events for the evening today. This will make both of you happy. By virtue of your good mood and health, you will be able to complete your routine tasks and that too at a super speed, says Ganesha. The support of your colleagues will be crucial for you today. It’s going to be a good day. Today, as you will be having financial gains, you will be happy. However, you will not be spending money without thinking much. You will be very logical while spending money. Your colleagues might be let off early today, but that will prove favourable for you. Due to this, you will be able to get your work done very fast today, feels Ganesha. The favourable day continues as your superiors may encourage you.

Today, arranging meetings with customers and suppliers will eat into most of your time. Your patience will enable you to listen to suggestions and opinions offered by people. The result of all this, however, is slated to be most favourable and productive. Your love life may remain demanding, to which you would not be able to pay attention. You will have to take care of this point. You should ensure that you manage to handle your partner’s emotions. This is important to make your day good. You will be very practical in your approach today. This is going to help you in various ways. It is going to make you happy. It is going to help you complete several tasks and meet some crucial deadlines, says Ganesha. Superiors are likely to favour you and may put your name ahead for the appraisals. If you are in the business, you are going to achieve new heights, obviously that would also mean more money. You will be less enthusiastic and more pragmatic in your approach towards work and related matters. Main reason behind this is, you now exactly know that some pending activities need to be given high priority. So, you will give more attention to these pending activities.

Ganesha can hear the wedding bells. There is all the likelihood that you will find your perfect match today and will let him/her know about your feelings, says Ganesha. Your family means the world to you and you will be more expressive about this today than you have been in the past few years. In fact, your warm feelings will be reciprocated in equal measure and you will be showered with love— unconditional and unrestrained. The day will be good for you from love life point of view, feels Ganesha. You may devote due time and attention to your love life. This is going to make him or her happy, which is going to make you happy. It’s a busy day for you, full of meetings and other tasks. You will consider luck important. You will be in a positive mood. All these developments will make you happier and you feel even better. You will consider it a good day. If you are in business, you will be able to take practical decisions, which will positively influence your finances too. On the whole, this is going to be a progressive day for financial matters. Ganesha finds doors of opportunities opening wide for you as you are seen calling for or attending meetings. You might depend on luck and also be in a mood to give due importance to other people’s opinions. It is a favourable day to fix deadlines.

Today, you work hard and party harder! The morning sees you sweating it out at work, as you do your best to implement your plans. In the evening, you will don your best attire and get ready to have a gala time with your beloved. Ganesha says, you receive as much as you give. There will not be much developments in your love life today. Your day will remain uneventful from the perspective of love relationship, feels Ganesha. It will be a routine and average day without much to make it different or special from other days. Your good mental health will ensure you success on multiple fronts, says Ganesha. You are going to fulfill several social and official obligations. You will be happy and will feel good about all this. It’s a good day for you. When luck is not in favour, one must try and work harder in order to set things right. If you build solid ground at job or in business, you will be able to build solid ground for financial progress. It is best day to have a look at past and finish off pending social and official work. At office, you may interact with others in order to find solution to some long-pending issues. Besides, Ganesha suggests you to beware of jealous people.

A highly productive day awaits you. You will be driven to succeed, and filled with energy and enthusiasm to achieve your goals. Meetings with your superiors ought to yield some much anticipated results, says Ganesha. Your love life may go very smooth and you may receive lot of love from the one you love the most. This is going to give you support and happiness, feels Ganesha. The developments on love front will be different from those on personal front. You are more emotional than others and you take things to heart. You need to be careful about this. You should take criticism constructively. You need to take care of all these points if you want it to be a good day. If you are married, this is a good time to gift something to spouse or take him/her out on an expensive candlelight dinner. While your focus will be on spending money, flow of income isn’t likely to be much. You may find yourself agreeing to what others feel and believe, be it home or office. As you are very emotional by nature, if someone tries to point out your mistakes, you may feel hurt but Ganesha suggests you not to feel offended.
